name: Compact Wall Bracket
subtitle: Proportional, stepped-depth, diagonally packed pair
description: A parametric reconstruction of the supplied triangular wall-bracket body. Span and rise stay locked to the measured source proportion, the base body and diagonal/center braces have separate depths, and the two-up export opposes and rotates the pair to use the square plate efficiently.

dimensionTargets: The supplied source mesh measures 190.9188 mm span by 99.9285 mm rise by 25.6 mm maximum depth, with a measured 8.96 mm recessed center depth.
The default remake measures 200 mm span by 104.6817 mm derived rise, preserving the source 1.91055:1 proportion.
The user-directed depth profile uses a 19.05 mm base body and a common 12.7 mm depth for the diagonal rails and center web, all flush to the build plate on one face.
Two default copies are opposed, separated by 5 mm normal to their adjacent diagonal edges, and rotated approximately 27.5 degrees for a roughly 232.4 mm square footprint.
invariants: Derive rise from span using the measured source aspect ratio; do not expose independent dimensions that can distort the original proportion.
Keep base-body depth independent from the shared diagonal-and-center depth, and keep every member flush to the same Z = 0 print face.
Preserve at least the measured 10 mm base rail, 6.4 mm diagonal rail, 6.4 mm center web, and 8.96 mm recessed-core depth.
The supplied source body contains no bolt bores or countersinks, so do not invent or rescale a bolt interface.
Keep the two-up export as two disconnected, individually manifold bracket shells; oppose the second bracket and derive the global rotation that minimizes the square plate envelope.
Treat plate fit as a conservative outer-triangle envelope check; verify brim, purge objects, exclusion zones, material, layer direction, fasteners, and real loading in the slicer and physical setup.

scripts.name: audit
scripts.description: Verifies source depth evidence, locked proportions, stepped-depth topology, opposed rotated packing, Z placement, and plate fit.
